subject: Private deployment: dataflow evidence & network isolation options
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Brown <alex.brown@medsys.com>, Priya Desai <pri.d@medsys.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-29T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Private deployment: dataflow evidence & network isolation options

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we can move the security qualification forward for the private/VPC deployment option: 

1) Compliance posture: you asked about SOC 2, GDPR, and HIPAA readiness. High level: Redwood is currently completing a SOC 2 Type II assessment for our inference platform (expected report Q2 2028). We maintain GDPR controls for EU data subject requests and have a HIPAA program (policies + BA template); legal can discuss BAA specifics — see note below.

2) Vendor/security questionnaire: please confirm you want us to complete your spreadsheet. To expedite, we can also push a completed vendor-questionnaire.xlsx (attached) and a short attestation cover note. Timeline: we aim to return the filled questionnaire within 3 business days after you confirm the scope.

3) Dataflow & network isolation: attached is an initial dataflow diagram (redwood-dataflow-diagram-v1.png) showing where tokens and persistent data are processed. Action item: please indicate whether Medsys requires an air-gapped (no internet egress) variant or a VPC-with-controlled-egress configuration. For the latter, we will document allowed egress IPs and ports.

4) Evidence & scans: we can share third-party scan summaries and pen-test reports (redacted) under an NDA. Preliminary scan summary attached.

Next steps (from our side):
- If you confirm scope (PHI in/out, retention needs), we will populate the vendor questionnaire and update the architecture diagram to include the air-gap and egress-control variants.
- Legal will prepare a BAA draft if you confirm PHI scope.

Can you confirm: a) which evidence items you need first (SOC 2 controls matrix / pen-test / diagram) and b) target date for questionnaire completion?

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

—
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive\Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0163

Attachments: redwood-dataflow-diagram-v1.png (image), vendor-questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet), thirdparty-scan-summary.pdf (pdf)

From: Alex Brown <alex.brown@medsys.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Priya Desai <pri.d@medsys.com>
Cc: Medsys Security <security@medsys.com>
Date: 2027-11-29T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment: dataflow evidence & network isolation options

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap. Couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Scope: Medsys will be sending PHI to the model as part of clinical note summarization (in US region only). We need evidence that PHI is processed in a private VPC and that persistent storage is under our control or meets our encryption/retention requirements.

- SOC 2: we need either the SOC 2 report or a controls matrix that maps your controls to our requirements while you complete Type II. The controls matrix + timeline is sufficient for the initial procurement review.

- BAA: yes, we need a draft BAA to review in parallel. Legal is available for a short sync if required.

- Air-gap vs controlled egress: we prefer to evaluate the controlled-egress VPC first (it’s lower-friction), but keep the air-gapped option as a fallback. Please include both in the updated diagram and call out the additional mitigations (physical isolation, no outbound DNS, limited maintenance windows) for air-gapped.

- Questionnaire: please fill out the attached vendor questionnaire and return within 10 business days. If you can do a 3–4 business day turnaround on the highest-priority sections (dataflow, encryption, access controls), that would be ideal.

We’ll also share any required procurement forms after we see the controls matrix.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Brown
Principal Product Security Manager, Medsys Health
alex.brown@medsys.com
